activeQuestion.prompt: What does the woman need by three?

options.text: The names of staff assigned to guide the tour.
options.zh: 負責導覽的工作人員名單。
options.whyZh: 她接下來負責更新訪客識別證，不是安排導覽人員。

options.text: The final visitor list, so she can update the badges.
options.zh: 最後確認的訪客名單，方便她更新訪客識別證。
options.whyZh: 對方先請她更新訪客識別證，她答應後請對方三點前給最後確認的名單。

options.text: The list of people who will lead the question session.
options.zh: 負責帶領問答的人員名單。
options.whyZh: 問答會移到午餐後；她要的名單是為了更新訪客識別證。

options.text: The client’s contact list for sending the advance slides.
options.zh: 用來先寄送簡報投影片的客戶聯絡名單。
options.whyZh: 雖然會先寄投影片，但她是在答應更新訪客識別證後才要求名單。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 對方先請她更新訪客識別證，她答應後請對方三點前給最後確認的名單。

group.title: A client visit agenda
group.passage:
Man: The client's flight now arrives at ten instead of eight. We will not have time for both the factory tour and the morning presentation.
Woman: The client asked specifically to see the assembly line. Let us keep the tour and send the presentation slides in advance.
Man: All right. I will move the question session to after lunch. Can you update the visitor badges?
Woman: Yes. Please send me the final list of names before three today.
group.passageZh:
男：客戶班機現在改為十點抵達，而不是八點。我們來不及同時安排工廠導覽和上午簡報。
女：客戶特別要求看組裝線。我們保留導覽，並提前寄出簡報。
男：好。我會把問答時段改到午餐後。你可以更新訪客證嗎？
女：可以。請在今天三點前寄給我最終名單。
